content.short: Open-source Chrome extension wallet for EVM chains with Metamask API compatibility and no data collection.
content.description: Clear EVM Wallet is an open-source Chrome extension wallet built on Ethers, Ionic, and Vue that works with EVM chains. It supports the MetaMask API, so websites will recognize it as MetaMask. Use it as a MetaMask replacement on your favorite Web3 sites. Features include data wiping, auto lock, export and import of accounts, and a perma-lock that requires a password to decrypt for every sign or transaction. It is lightweight, under 400KB, and does not collect any data.
content.meta: Clear EVM Wallet is an open-source Chrome extension wallet for EVM chains. Discover Clear EVM Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
